da-empirical-fragility.evidence: The quoted -0.114 sigma is inside the G_F noise (sigma = 257 ppb on v/m_p), so the comparison cannot distinguish the published formula from any variant within +-257 ppb (e.g. c=h^2 moves it 0.15 ppb); with the selection disclosed this is a fit-noise match.
